import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c = load("examples/service.conf")
print(c.get("level", section="logging"), c.get("json", section="logging"), c.get("port", section="http"), c.get("name"))
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.mkdir(d+"/sub")
w = lambda n, t: open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").write(t)
w("a.conf", "x = 1\n@include sub/b.conf\ny = 9\n")
w("sub/b.conf", "x = 2\ny = 2\n@include c.conf\n")
w("sub/c.conf", "z = 3\n")
c = load(d+"/a.conf"); print(c.get("x"), c.get("y"), c.get("z"))
w("sub/c.conf", "@include ../a.conf\n")

except ConfigError as e: print("cycle:", e)
w("s.conf", "@include s.conf\n")
try: load(d+"/s.conf")
except ConfigError as e: print("self:", e)
w("m.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
try: load(d+"/m.conf")
except ConfigError as e: print("missing:", e)
EOF
